1: Apne Rubb ki buzurgi bayan kijiye, jo apni makhlooq se buland hai, us ka naam le kar jab aap usey yaad karein aur us ki tazeem karein.
2: Wohi hai jis ne insan ko theek andaze se paida kiya aur us ke dhanche ko tawazun diya.
3: Wohi hai jis ne tamam makhlooq ke liye un ki qismein, anwaa aur sifaat muqarrar kin, aur har makhlooq ko us cheez ki raah dikhai jo us ke liye munasib aur mufeed hai.
4: Wohi hai jis ne zameen se woh cheez nikali jo tumhare jaanwar charte hain.
5: Phir us ne usey, hara-bhara aur taaza hone ke baad, sookha siyah bhoosa bana diya.
6: Aey Rasool ﷺ, main aap ko Quran sikhaunga aur usey aap ke seene mein jama kar doonga, taake aap usey na bhoolein. Pas aap tilawat mein Jibreel (alaihis salaam) se aage barhne ki koshish na karein, jaisa aap is khauf se karte thay ke aap bhool jayenge.
7: Siwaye us ke jo Allah kisi hikmat ke tahat aap se bhula dena chahe. Woh, jo paak hai, jaanta hai jo zahir hai aur jo chhupa hua hai. Us mein se kuch us se chhupa nahin.
8: Main aap ke liye aise aamaal aasan kar doonga jo Allah ko pasand hain aur jo aap ko jannat mein daakhil karenge.
9: Pas us Quran ke zariye logon ko nasihat kijiye jo main aap par utarta hoon, aur unhein yaad dilaiye, jab tak nasihat suni jaati rahe.
10: Jo Allah se darta hai, woh aap ki nasihat par tawajjoh dega, kyunke wohi nasihat se faida uthata hai.
11: Aur kafir nasihat se door rahega aur us se kinara karega, kyunke woh aakhirat mein sab se bad-naseeb hai, kyunke woh aag mein daakhil hoga.
12: Wohi jo aakhirat ki bari aag mein daakhil hoga, taake hamesha us ki garmi uthaye aur bardasht kare.
13: Phir woh us aag mein hamesha rahega: na us mein marega ke us azaab se nijaat pa jaye, aur na achhi aur qabil-e-qabool zindagi guzaregа.
14: Jis ne apne aap ko shirk aur gunahon se paak kar liya, us ne maqsad pa liya,
15: jis ne apne Rubb ko un tamam tareeqon se yaad kiya jo us ne muqarrar kiye, aur jis ne namaz us tarah ada ki jis tarah ka hukm tha.
16: Magar tum duniya ki zindagi ko tarjeeh dete ho aur usey aakhirat par fauqiyat dete ho, bawajood is ke ke dono mein bahut bara farq hai.
17: Beshak aakhirat duniya se aur us ki tamam lazzaton aur aishon se behtar aur baland hai, aur zyada baaqi rehne wali hai, kyunke us ki niyamat kabhi khatam nahin hoti.
18: Yeh hidayaten aur qisse jo maine aap se bayan kiye, woh un sahifon mein bhi hain jo aap se pehle utare gaye,
19: yani un sahifon mein jo Ibrahim aur Moosa (alaihimus salaam) par utare gaye.
